description: Claim -> Evidence: does this source actually say what you're about to cite it for? Send a claim and the source URL; get SUPPORTED with the exact sentence, PARTIAL with the closest sentences and which numbers/names are missing, NOT_FOUND, or CHECK_NEGATION when the matching sentence denies it. Strict: every number must appear next to the claim's own names (no borrowing another plan's price). Deterministic, no AI calls. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/claim-evidence, $0.005 via x402.)
